WWE Wrestling Ultimate Edition Gunther Action Figure

WWE Ultimate Edition action figures feature favorite Superstars with swappable hands, multiple heads, and authentic attire. Highly detailed with TrueFX life-like features and more than 30 points of articulation, these 6-inch figure and accessories sets let WWE collectors and kids recreate everything from entrance poses to in-ring finishers.
